finalText:
Last night's deploy failed because migration 0042 timed out — the timeout happened because events.user_id has no index in prod, and the index exists in staging but prod never got it since migration 0041 was manually marked as applied back in 2024.

Along the way: read 14 files, ruled out three dead-end theories (OOM, a bad env var, a stale docker cache), and noticed two flaky tests unrelated to this failure. No code changes were made this session.
